explanation.en: Use the past simple for finished times (yesterday, in 2019, last week): I visited Rome in 2019. Use the present perfect for experiences and results that matter now, with no finished time: I have visited Rome three times.
explanation.ar: استخدم الماضي البسيط مع زمن منتهٍ (yesterday، in 2019، last week): I visited Rome in 2019. واستخدم المضارع التام للتجارب والنتائج المهمة الآن دون زمن منتهٍ: I have visited Rome three times.

examples: I have never been to Japan.
I have never been to Japan.
She lost her keys yesterday.
She lost her keys yesterday.
Have you finished your homework?
Have you finished your homework?

explanation.en: Make suggestions with Why don't we…?, How about + -ing, and I suggest (that) we + verb. Express wishes about the present with I wish + past simple: I wish I had more time.
explanation.ar: قدّم الاقتراحات بـ Why don't we…? وHow about + -ing وI suggest (that) we + فعل. وعبّر عن أمنيات في الحاضر بـ I wish + ماضٍ بسيط: I wish I had more time.

examples: How about going to the cinema?
How about going to the cinema?
I suggest that we leave early.
I suggest that we leave early.
I wish I spoke Spanish.
I wish I spoke Spanish.

explanation.en: First conditional for real possibilities: If it rains, we will stay at home. Second conditional for imaginary situations: If I had more money, I would travel more. Advice: If I were you, I would…
explanation.ar: الشرطية الأولى للاحتمالات الواقعية: If it rains, we will stay at home. والثانية للمواقف الخيالية: If I had more money, I would travel more. وللنصيحة: If I were you, I would…

examples: If you study, you will pass.
If you study, you will pass.
If I were you, I would call her.
If I were you, I would call her.
What would you do if you won the lottery?
What would you do if you won the lottery?

explanation.en: Use who for people, which for things and where for places to add information: The woman who lives next door is a doctor. The book which I bought is great. That's the café where we met.
explanation.ar: استخدم who للأشخاص وwhich للأشياء وwhere للأماكن لإضافة معلومات: The woman who lives next door is a doctor. The book which I bought is great. That's the café where we met.

examples: This is the man who helped me.
This is the man who helped me.
I like films which make me laugh.
I like films which make me laugh.
That's the town where I grew up.
That's the town where I grew up.

exercises.text: For the past two years, Sam has worked from home three days a week. At first he loved it: he didn't waste time in traffic and could organise his own day. However, after a few months he started to feel lonely and missed chatting with his colleagues. Now he goes to the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and he says he has found the perfect balance.

questions.p: What did Sam like at first?
What problem did he have later?
What does he do now?
o: He goes to the office two days a week
He always works in the office

exercises.text: More and more European cities are closing their historic centres to traffic. Supporters say the air is cleaner and streets regain a sense of community. Shopkeepers, on the other hand, feared losing customers; yet several studies suggest that sales have actually risen, because pedestrians stroll more and stop in shops. Even so, the debate continues in cities where public transport is not good enough.

questions.p: What were shopkeepers afraid of?
According to studies, what has happened to sales?
Where does the debate continue?
o: Where public transport is not good enough

exercises.text: Hello, this is Riverside Dental. Your appointment on Wednesday at ten has to be moved because the dentist is ill. We can offer you Thursday at the same time or Friday at four. Please call us back before Tuesday to confirm. Thank you.

questions.p: Why is the appointment moving?
Which options are offered?
o: Thursday at ten or Friday at four
